steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json containing the application name and package name details.

steps.title: Define Offline API Schema
steps.description: Configure api_schema.json with backend disabled for offline-only 3D geometric operations.

steps.title: Configure Build System
steps.description: Define build.gradle using specified compiler SDK 34, AGP 8.3.2, and Java 17.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Declare the package, application class, launcher MainActivity, and light Material theme.

steps.title: Define Application Resources
steps.description: Add string resources, themes, and dimensions needed for custom 3D drawing controls.

steps.title: Create 3D Custom Rendering Canvas View
steps.description: Implement ThreeDView.java to handle perspective projection, matrix rotations, custom coordinate math, and user touch drag gestures.

steps.title: Implement Geometric Wireframe Generator
steps.description: Add support in ThreeDView to build vertices and lines for Cube, Sphere, Cone, Cylinder, Pyramid, and customizable 3D mathematical surfaces.

steps.title: Design Interactive Calculator Interface Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml with clean material UI inputs, custom shape selector, results cards, and the 3D drawing view.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Logic and Event Listeners
steps.description: Add Java controller logic in MainActivity.java to bind elements, capture inputs, handle dropdown change states, and calculate volume/area.

steps.title: Integrate 3D Interactive Controls and Visual Updates
steps.description: Connect formula outputs, shape parameter changes, and surface graph parameters instantly to the custom rendering canvas.

steps.title: Verify UI States and Mathematical Accuracy
steps.description: Conduct robust error checks on negative values, empty inputs, and optimize rendering of custom wireframe vertices.

steps.title: Building 3D Calculator
steps.description: Compile the complete Android application project with local calculations and interactive 3D capabilities.
